name: Grid wave propagation
visual_intent: A field of cells (tiles, dots, shapes) changes state as a wave travelling out from an origin, turning a pattern into a visible event and a transition into a ripple.

performance_characteristics.memory_profile: Low for a few hundred cells (estimate)

implementation_summary: One fromTo over all cells with GSAP's grid stagger ({grid: [rows, cols], from, amount}); presets pop (scale in), flip (quarter turn from each cell's seeded base rotation) and tint, or custom vars. Studio.draw.grid builds the cells and can fill them with quarter-arc Truchet tiles.
runtime_api: Studio.fx.gridWave(tl, cells, at, {preset, grid, from, amount, duration, ease, fromVars, toVars}); Studio.draw.grid(parent, rows, cols, {truchet})

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test (hidden before, centre before corner, all settled, quarter turns exact) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
